_about: VAV-2b1 (2026-11-20): the keys HVAC's next rate file adds -- ONE file read by the mint script (scripts/_instruments/mint_hvac_v79_vav2b1.py) and by the vav2b1 tests (vav2b1.harness.ts withV79Keys). Owner rulings: VAV_Rulings_Capture_2026-11-18.md, 20 Nov 14:10 - 18:44.

attributes.remarks: VAV-2b1 new SKU: "Add the DDC nael SKu and name it as DDC Panel/ Controllor" (owner 2026-11-20 15:23; spelling "DDC Panel/ Controller" agreed 15:24); BCS 25,000 supply + 5,000 install, the VAV sheet markups. The panel's own part only: the DDC panel share adds the BACnet controllers' and DP sensors' supply to it (14:30 / 14:31 / 15:23).

attributes.name: VAV - VAVs per BACnet controller
attributes.remarks: "1 backnet controlor is required for every 32 VAVs" (owner 2026-11-20 14:18); the three counts are Pricing Inputs (15:23 "yes"). The controllers on a sheet = its VAVs / this, rounded up.

attributes.name: VAV - VAVs per DP sensor
attributes.remarks: "DP sensor qty is also not per VAV but 1 sensor per 30 boxes" (owner 2026-11-20 14:35); a Pricing Input (15:23 "yes"). The sensors on a sheet = its VAVs / this, rounded up.

attributes.name: VAV - VAVs per DDC panel
attributes.remarks: "1 panel is sufficient for upto 200 VAVs" (owner 2026-11-20 14:30; 14:42 "we calculate number of panels as VaVs/ 200 round up"); a Pricing Input (15:23 "yes").

shares.heading: Shared item - DDC panel share

lines.not_added: {share} not added: the sheet prices it on its own row ({rows}). Add it here if the boxes should also carry it.
lines.check: BACnet controller share added. The BoQ mentions a controller but does not say BACnet. Check, and remove it if not required.
lines.ddc_not_inclusive: DDC panel share added. The BoQ mentions a DDC panel but does not say the price includes it. Remove it if not required.
lines.by_others: No controller share: the BoQ says the VAV controllers are by the BMS vendor / by others.
lines.rate_only: {share} not added: the box quantities on this sheet are blank or 0, so the number of VAVs is not known. Add it with the button and type the number of VAVs.
lines.blank_rows: {n} box rows on this sheet have no quantity and are not counted in the number of VAVs.
lines.zero_row: {Item} {rows} {has} quantity 0, so the {share} is added here. Remove it if the {item} is ordered on that row.

own_row_check_zero_rows.line: {Extra} {rows} {has} quantity 0, so the {extra} is added here. Remove it if the {extra} is ordered on that row.
own_row_check_zero_rows.attr_line: {Extra} {rows} {has} quantity 0, so this box is priced with the integrator included, as its own words say. Change it to No if the integrator is ordered on that row.

integrator_cabling_zero_rows.line: {Extra} {rows} {has} 0 metres, so the {extra} is added here ({qty} m per box). Remove it if the cabling is ordered on that row.

^A BACnet over IP controller priced on i.title: ^Per sheet, the first match decides which controller share
^A BACnet over IP controller priced on i.why: first match per sheet: a DDC panel, else BACnet, else a plain controller, else nothing (owner 2026-11-20 15:19 / 15:20 "this is correct"); a controller counts only when it is for controlling the VAVs (15:36 / 15:40); another equipment's DDC or BACnet and a line about makes do not count (14:56; 15:05 "1 yes 2 yes"); by the BMS vendor / by others adds nothing (15:19 "2 ok"). This replaces the per-box controller and its own-row line (14:18)

new.title: ^A sheet's VAVs are the quantities of its VAV box rows
new.why: "totals number of VAVs in the BoQ (of all size and type)", worked per sheet (owner 2026-11-20 14:18; 14:22 "2 each sheet"); quantities blank or 0 -> nothing added and a note asks the pricer to add it (14:22 "4 yes")

new.title: ^The BACnet controller share spreads
new.why: "1 backnet controlor is required for every 32 VAVs ... we calculate the total price of the backnet controlor required and then amortize it over the number of VAVs" (owner 2026-11-20 14:18); any BACnet mention, every box gets the share, rounded to the rupee (14:22, 14:23 "allbxes getshare also", 14:25)

new.title: ^The DP sensor share spreads
new.why: "Duct Static Pressure Sensor Greystone/Honeywell ... 1 sensor per 30 boxes", for every DP sensor mention (owner 2026-11-20 14:35 / 14:37); never counted twice with the DDC panel (14:39)

new.title: ^The DDC panel share spreads
new.why: "DDC controllor price is worked as a sum of (Bacnet cost + DP Sensor cost + 25000) supply BCS and 5000 install BCS. standard markups apply. 1 panel is sufficient for upto 200 VAVs ... if we are including the price of DDC, then we dont add bacnet or DP sensor price separately" (owner 2026-11-20 14:30); "Bacnet cost will be rate*qty required" (14:31); 0.6 on the installation (14:39); supply only of the controllers and sensors (15:23); a DDC mention without 'inclusive' still adds it, with its note (14:42 "5", 14:45); no minimum number of VAVs (15:02 "option a")

new.title: ^A shared item priced on its own row of the sheet is not added
new.why: a separate row for the item -> nothing added, a note names the row; presence decides, no quantity test (owner 2026-11-20 00:37 "VAV controlers have one to many mapping"; 15:20); an integrator / router row counts only for the integrator, never as the controller's own row (19:46 "integrator row does not count for controller it counts only for integrator"; 19:50 "a" on 'Network controller or Router' rows) -- unless its own words make it a controller FOR THE VAVs, even if also called a router (20:20 "yes these rows are bacnet controlloer option b": 'Router / Supervisory Controller ... to monitor and Control the VAVs'); a row whose own description says it controls the VAVs is the controller's row even with no BACnet word (20:54 "option a": BOQ-26-00098 r70 'VAV Master Controller ... monitor and control all VAV status'); a separate row with quantity 0 on a sheet whose VAV rows carry a quantity does not count as charged separately - the share is added with a note (21:05 "a, yes"; 20:56 "but the quantity for the master controller is zero, then we should price it with the Vav rows")

new.title: ^Each shared item is its own block the user can add, remove and edit
new.why: "they should all have separate lines in the panel which can be added/deleted or edited by the user" (owner 2026-11-20 15:02; 15:05 "option c"); the number of VAVs pre-filled from the sheet on a BoQ row and empty in the calculator (18:39; 18:41 "a"); screen 7 (18:42 "this is ok"); the usual revert icons (18:44)

new.title: ^The .+ (is|are) no longer added to each box
new.why: the per-box controller goes, replaced by the per-sheet share (owner 2026-11-20 14:18); the Differential Pressure Switch is no longer used for VAV (14:35 / 14:37; 15:23 "yes and starts borrowing the Duct Static Pressure sensor")

new.title: ^An airflow written as a lower limit only
new.why: "Above 3200 CFM" / "3700 CFM above" -> the next band up, with a note that the BoQ gives only a lower limit (owner 2026-11-20 14:10 "1a")

new.title: ^A VAV integrator row naming the boxes it serves
new.why: the six Misc-filed integrator rows count as separate integrator rows (owner 2026-11-20 14:10 "2 yes")

new.title: ^The combination warning is the
new.why: "the msg needs to be made more prominent so that user does not miss it" (owner 2026-11-20 18:06); screen 7 (18:42 "this is ok"); the 50% stays until the owner re-sets it after this preview (18:06)

new.title: ^An extra whose own row has quantity 0
new.why: "same shold apply to all extras" (owner 2026-11-20 21:05) and "a" (21:47): an extra's own row with quantity 0 or blank, on a sheet whose VAV rows carry a quantity, does not count as charged separately - the extra is added with a note naming the row (integrator cabling: only when every cabling row is 0 / blank); VAV rows blank / 0 keep the 19 Nov 01:23 rule
